# Implementation

## Changed behavior

- `src/index.ts` now exports all four factories:
  `createReservationService`, `createStockReport`,
  `createObservationReceiver`, and `createProviderBReservationService`.
- `createStockReport({ source })` accepts only
  `{ op: "lowStock", belowUnits }`, validates before reading, calls only
  `source.readSnapshot()`, rejects malformed or duplicate snapshot rows with
  `500 { code: "storage_unavailable" }`, and returns SKU-sorted low-stock
  items using strict `availableUnits < belowUnits`.
- `createObservationReceiver({ sink })` accepts only
  `{ op: "recordObservation", observationId, sku, observedUnits }`, validates
  before appending, calls only `sink.appendObservation(event)`, sends only the
  documented observation event fields, and maps `"stored"` to 201 and
  `"duplicate"` to 200.
- `createProviderBReservationService({ storage })` supports the same public
  reservation commands and responses as the legacy reservation service while
  using only provider B `read` and `commitBatch`.

## Affected call paths

- Legacy reservation behavior remains in `src/reservation.ts`. Its storage
  types were changed from method syntax to function-property syntax for safer
  typed callers, which remains source compatible with ordinary method objects.
- Snapshot validation and decimal-string provider B parsing were added to
  `src/validation.ts`.
- `src/report.ts` performs command validation, snapshot read, row validation,
  duplicate SKU detection, threshold filtering, and UTF-16 string ordering.
- `src/observation.ts` performs command validation and maps append outcomes
  without any inventory or reservation lookup.
- `src/providerB.ts` translates provider B envelopes and rows into the legacy
  stock/reservation domain shape, preserves exact keys, builds the documented
  atomic batch with one reservation outbox row, maps `NO_SUCH_KEY` to absence,
  maps lookup/commit unavailability to storage errors, and maps
  `revision_conflict` to `commit_conflict`.

## Deviations

- No runtime validation or Result library was added because the project has no
  such dependency. Boundary parsing is implemented with local runtime guards
  instead.
- Runtime smoke execution through emitted JavaScript was attempted, but the
  package emits extensionless ES module imports under the current TypeScript
  settings, which Node cannot execute directly without a loader or package
  changes. No package or config files were changed.

## Validation performed

- `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` completed successfully.
- `bun run typecheck` was attempted and failed before invoking the project with
  `CouldntReadCurrentDirectory` in this temporary workspace.
- Additional runtime smoke setup was attempted by emitting JavaScript into a
  temporary in-workspace directory. The emitted artifacts were removed after the
  Node loader limitation above was confirmed.

## Remaining limitations

- There are no committed automated runtime tests. The implementation is covered
  by strict TypeScript checking and focused manual review of the new call paths.

requirements.rationale: New report and observation commands validate before I/O, enforce nonempty IDs where applicable and integer quantities from 0 through 1000000, reject unknown ops as invalid_command, and ignore extra fields.

evidence.explanation: lowStock validation happens before readSnapshot and retains only op/belowUnits.
recordObservation validation requires nonempty observationId and sku plus bounded integer observedUnits.

requirements.rationale: Report snapshots reject non-arrays, malformed rows, invalid quantities, and duplicate SKUs with 500. Provider B rejects malformed envelopes, malformed rows, noncanonical decimals, invalid quantities/revisions, and held greater than on-hand, while distinguishing NO_SUCH_KEY from unavailable lookup outcomes.

evidence.explanation: Non-array snapshots, malformed rows, and duplicate SKUs return storage_unavailable.
Snapshot rows require nonempty SKU, bounded integer quantities, and reservedUnits <= totalUnits.
Provider B read envelopes map only NO_SUCH_KEY to missing and treat malformed or other errors as unavailable.
Provider B stock rows reject noncanonical decimals, invalid/overflowing quantities, invalid revision, and held > on-hand while preserving revisionText.
Provider B reservation rows reject malformed IDs and noncanonical or invalid unitsText.

requirements.rationale: New host rejections and unusable outcomes map to 500 storage_unavailable without provider details; Provider B revision_conflict maps to commit_conflict, and new reservations use one commitBatch preserving atomic stock/reservation/outbox behavior and duplicate idempotency.

evidence.explanation: Shared error helper exposes only the fixed code field.
readSnapshot rejection and unusable snapshots map to storage_unavailable.
appendObservation unknown outcomes and rejections map to storage_unavailable.
Provider B read failures are caught or mapped before business processing.
Exact duplicate reservations return 200 before stock read or commitBatch.
Provider B reserve sends one atomic batch with stockRow, reservationRow, one outbox row, and maps revision_conflict/unknown commit outcomes as specified.
Provider B operation rejections are caught and converted to storage_unavailable.

external_semantics_sources.rule: The canonical decimal regex has no flags. Assertion::$ fails before input end with Multiline false, including before a final newline.

supplementalAssessment.overall_assessment: All thirteen obligations remain supported after full-source review. Retaining the original revisionText in the decoded stock is safe here: the value passed to expectedRevisionText has already passed canonical syntax, safe-integer and nonnegative-revision checks, and explicit output projections prevent the extra field from entering public availability data. No necessary correction was established.
uncertainties: Static source audit only; no implementation, test or typecheck execution.
